author: Yffe
content: Fixed in 6d7b3af. Root cause: cache_key omitted the verdict-affecting check-logic version, so the #12 §7 mutation gate (shipped at the same forge 0.1.0) left a pre-gate L3-clean cert under the IDENTICAL key, re-served on a warm HIT and bypassing the gate. Fix (single file forge/src/cache.rs): +CHECK_SCHEMA_VERSION as a 5th domain-tagged length-prefixed cache_key input with a bump-on-gate-change maintenance contract; cache::load now treats an internally-inconsistent entry (clean reject:None but a Failed obligation) as a MISS, forcing re-check under current gates. divergence_stale_same_version_cache_entry_bypasses_mutation_gate now PASSES. No regression: cache_hit_serves_l3_with_verus_unavailable + second_run_is_a_cache_hit + corpus sum/binary_search L3 cold+warm all green. Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 255 passed 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS. cache_key stays pure (R-CODE-5). No conformance fixtures or test assertions touched.
